lines.text: You're awake. Good. Can you hear me?
You need a shield. Two packs of Cragbacks guard a supply case to the north. Defeat them, then claim it.
D-pad to move. A fires. B jumps. Watch the rock landing marks and keep moving. I'll stay on this channel.
Shield online. It takes the hit first. Get clear for a moment and it will recharge.
You earned that. It'll help with what comes next.
Follow the pass north to Dust Crossroads. The road north from there reaches town.
You're inside. For now, that's enough.
Who are you? Why help me?
Someone who needs you alive. Find your feet. I'll be in touch.
